pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions; pyramiding is authorized only after price moves in favor by 2x ATR with the previous entry stop-loss locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe RSI and EMA slope alignment check to block entries during high-impact counter-trend momentum candles.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop-loss compression once open trade profit reaches +$12.00 to lock in the $15-$30+ asymmetric target zone.
